title: Independently Verifiable COSE_Sign1 and IETF SCITT Decision Receipts

name.const: Independently Verifiable COSE_Sign1 and IETF SCITT Decision Receipts

description.const: System owners must emit signed, append-only IETF SCITT (RFC 9162) / COSE_Sign1 cryptographic audit receipts for every state-mutating agent decision to enable offline regulatory verification.

receipt-envelope-format.description: Open cryptographic receipt envelope format for offline audit verification.

offline-verification-supported.description: Receipts must be independently verifiable offline without trusting mutable application databases.

minimum-retention-days.description: Minimum regulatory audit retention period in days (7 years = 2555 days).
